summary: Preinstall script drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-obfuscated and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmod +x's the `bun` binary, then invokes it on a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB bun-compiled, obfuscator.io-style bundle (string-array with rotation function, character-code lookup, `_0x`-style identifiers) that has no relationship to the package's advertised React UI (Anvil2) purpose. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is listed in `package.json.files` (which declares only `dist` and `CHANGELOG.md`), yet both are shipped in the tarball and reached from the preinstall hook. package.json ships with empty `author`, empty `description`, and empty `keywords` under a scope (`@servicetitan`) matching an established vendor. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: fetching a non-Node runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle at install time evades Node-based static analysis, and the executed content is unrelated to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
